caption: Frame 2 is damaged, so Go-Back-N resends frames 2 to 6 (5 extra transmissions, 12 in all) while Selective Repeat resends only frame 2 (1 extra, 8 in all). Each cell is one frame sent; the faded cell is the damaged frame 2.

spec.title: Frames 0–6, frame 2 damaged (k = 3)
spec.aria: Two rows of frame transmissions for the same seven frames with frame 2 damaged: Go-Back-N sends 7 new frames then resends frames 2 to 6 for 12 transmissions, while Selective Repeat sends 7 new frames and resends only frame 2 for 8 transmissions.
